# Tools reference

<!-- Generated by tests/gen_tools_md.py from the op registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

104 tools. Every tool is an MCP tool of the same name; this is the data `tools/list` serves (descriptions, types, ranges), plus the parameter defaults. Unknown parameters are rejected. A tool marked *read-only* works while "Allow scene changes" is off; *changes the scene* tools are refused with `read_only` until the user turns it on, and each one is a single undo step. *Destructive* is the MCP `destructiveHint`: the tool removes or irreversibly rewrites existing data. Errors come back as `{code, message}`; the codes are listed in the [README](README.md#errors).

Regenerate with `blender --background --factory-startup --python tests/gen_tools_md.py`.

## Session and diagnostics

What the server is doing, and undo/redo of its own steps.

### get_status

*read-only*

Blender version, current file, scene and safety state.

No parameters.

### list_ops

*read-only*

List every operation this addon accepts, with JSON schemas.

No parameters.

### get_debug_logs

*read-only*

Recent log records from the Blender addon (connections, every op with its outcome and timing, refusals, and full tracebacks of crashes). Pass the returned last_id as since_id to get only newer records.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer 1..500 | `100` |  |
| `min_level` | `DEBUG` \| `INFO` \| `WARNING` \| `ERROR` | `"DEBUG"` |  |
| `since_id` | integer 0..9007199254740992 | `0` |  |
| `errors_only` | boolean | false |  |

### undo

*changes the scene, destructive*

Undo the last steps of Blender's undo history. Each MCP change is one step, but so is each edit the user makes in Blender (even a selection). Returns the steps actually undone and which objects were added, removed or changed.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer 1..50 | `1` |  |

### redo

*changes the scene, destructive*

Redo undone steps. Returns the steps actually redone and which objects were added, removed or changed. Any new change discards the redo history.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | integer 1..50 | `1` |  |

## Looking at the scene

Read-only inspection, viewport capture and rendering.

### get_scene_info

*read-only*

Scene summary: render engine, frame range, camera, world, and up to 100 objects with transforms.

No parameters.

### list_objects

*read-only*

Objects in the scene, filtered by name substring and/or type.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string ≤63 | none |  |
| `type` | `MESH` \| `CURVE` \| `FONT` \| `LIGHT` \| `CAMERA` \| `EMPTY` \| `ARMATURE` \| `SURFACE` \| `META` \| `VOLUME` \| `GPENCIL` \| `GREASEPENCIL` \| `POINTCLOUD` \| `CURVES` \| `LATTICE` \| `SPEAKER` \| `LIGHT_PROBE` | none |  |
| `limit` | integer 1..500 | `50` |  |

### get_object_info

*read-only*

Details for one object: transform, world bounding box, mesh stats, materials, modifiers, children.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |

### get_property

*read-only*

Read a property through an allow-listed RNA path. An empty path, or a path ending on a struct, lists that struct's accessible properties.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | object | **required** | Datablock to start from. 'scene' and 'world' default to the current ones. |
| `target.kind` | `object` \| `material` \| `world` \| `scene` \| `mesh` \| `light` \| `camera` \| `curve` \| `texture` | **required** |  |
| `target.name` | string ≤63 | none | Datablock name |
| `path` | array[0..16] of string ≤63 or integer -100000..100000 | **required** | RNA path as a list, e.g. ["modifiers", "Bevel", "width"] or ["data", "energy"]. Collections are followed by an index or item name. |

### capture_viewport

*read-only*

Return a PNG of the 3D viewport as currently shown, or through a camera (OpenGL preview, not a render). Fast; use it often to check your work.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_size` | integer 64..2048 | `800` |  |
| `camera` | boolean or string ≤63 | false | true = scene camera, or a camera name |

### set_viewport

*read-only*

Move the user's 3D viewport (not the scene camera): orbit, recenter, zoom, or switch perspective. Returns the resulting view. Changes no scene data.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orbit_right_deg` | number -360..360 | none | Orbit the view to the right around its center (world Z axis) |
| `orbit_up_deg` | number -180..180 | none | Orbit the view upward (see more from above) |
| `center` | number[3] -1000000..1000000 | none | XYZ in scene units |
| `distance` | number 0.001..1000000 | none |  |
| `perspective` | `PERSP` \| `ORTHO` \| `CAMERA` | none |  |

### render_image

*read-only*

Render the scene camera with the current engine at reduced size/samples and return a PNG. Slow (seconds to minutes); Blender is blocked meanwhile.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `max_size` | integer 64..2048 | `800` |  |
| `samples` | integer 1..256 | `32` |  |

### join_objects

*changes the scene, destructive*

Join mesh objects into one (like Ctrl+J): the others' geometry, UVs and materials move into target, keeping their world placement; the others are removed. Target's own modifiers then apply to the whole result. For a watertight solid from overlapping/touching shapes, use a BOOLEAN modifier (UNION) + apply_modifiers instead.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |
| `others` | array[1..100] of string ≤63 | **required** | Mesh objects merged into target and removed |
| `apply_modifiers` | boolean | true | Bake the others' modifiers first so they keep their look (their stacks are lost otherwise) |
| `merge_distance` | number 0..1 | none | Afterwards, weld vertices closer than this (0/omitted = don't) |

## Modifiers

### add_modifier

*changes the scene*

Add a modifier and set its properties. target_object sets the Boolean/Shrinkwrap target, Mirror/Array offset object or the CURVE (Curve Deform) modifier's curve object (must be a CURVE). curve_object (ARRAY only, must be a CURVE) sets the curve for Array's fit-to-curve and switches fit_type to FIT_CURVE.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |
| `type` | `SUBSURF` \| `BEVEL` \| `ARRAY` \| `MIRROR` \| `SOLIDIFY` \| `BOOLEAN` \| `DECIMATE` \| `SMOOTH` \| `CORRECTIVE_SMOOTH` \| `LAPLACIANSMOOTH` \| `WIREFRAME` \| `SCREW` \| `TRIANGULATE` \| `WELD` \| `REMESH` \| `SIMPLE_DEFORM` \| `CAST` \| `WAVE` \| `EDGE_SPLIT` \| `SHRINKWRAP` \| `SKIN` \| `WEIGHTED_NORMAL` \| `DISPLACE` \| `BUILD` \| `CURVE` | **required** |  |
| `name` | string ≤63 | none | Datablock name |
| `settings` | object | none |  |
| `target_object` | string ≤63 | none | Datablock name |
| `curve_object` | string ≤63 | none | Datablock name |

### remove_modifier

*changes the scene, destructive*

Remove a modifier.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |
| `name` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |

### apply_modifiers

*changes the scene, destructive*

Bake the whole modifier stack of a mesh object into its mesh.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |

### set_modifier_texture

*changes the scene*

Point a modifier's texture slot at a procedural texture (DISPLACE and WAVE have one), or clear it with null. texture_coords picks the mapping; OBJECT needs texture_coords_object (an object name) and UV needs uv_layer (an existing UV map of the mesh; see list_uv_maps).

| Parameter | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `object` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |
| `modifier` | string ≤63 | **required** | Datablock name |
| `texture` | _NameOrNull | **required** | Texture name, or null to clear |
| `texture_coords` | `LOCAL` \| `GLOBAL` \| `OBJECT` \| `UV` | none |  |
| `texture_coords_object` | string ≤63 | none | Datablock name |
| `uv_layer` | string ≤63 | none | Datablock name |
